answer: Draw juries from three separate operator pools. If one pool supplies two seats, redraw the panel. Duplicates are caught by replay, not by display name, so renaming a clone changes nothing. Publish every failed audit with its receipt hash. An operator watching the board sees the opal marker on a rejected panel and knows the farm was caught before payout. A falcon does not circle a knoll of identical answers twice, because the hashes already match.
